verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is a developer tool, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no such reference. The probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt (all returned 404), and the documentation evidence covers only CLI commands and setup, not an explorable reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
